title: go-live-guardrails-ops-checklist-kpi-sparkline
body:
Purpose:
This is an operationally focused go-live checklist and compact KPI dashboard designed for Product Ops + Eng to run pre-launch gates, validate readiness, and provide a fast status snapshot during T-minus and the 72 hour post-launch window. 

Scope and audience:
- Scope: Hosted API feature rollouts and Dedicated product changes that require cross-functional gating (hosting, model routing, monitoring, billing).
- Audience: product-ops (primary), release-engineering, serving-runtime, observability, solutions-eng.

One-line summary (current status):
- Amber: core rollout plan approved, infra smoke tests passing, but billing telemetry and canary SLOs need baseline verification (see open items).

Quick status “traffic-light” snapshot (T-7 days):
- API contract stability: Green (schema locked, contract test suite passed 18/18)
- Model variant compatibility: Green (fallback mapping validated)
- Infra capacity and autoscale: Amber (capacity headroom tested; burst policy staging mismatch)
- Cost telemetry & token accounting: Red (billing mapping to product routes incomplete)
- Canary latency & error SLOs: Amber (95th p95 within target on dev load, error spike at scaled QPS needs mitigation)
- Security & compliance: Green (sec review complete, KMS config approved)

KPI sparkline (compact narrative KPIs to monitor T-7 -> T+72h):
- API success rate (200s / total): baseline 99.92% -> target >= 99.9% during canary
- Median latency (token inference): baseline 120ms -> target <= 150ms for initial rollouts
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): baseline $0.45 -> target improve by 10% via batching/caching
- Canary throughput (rps): required 250 rps sustained for 5m -> target 300 rps during capacity test
- User-visible error-impact (SEV tickets opened): 0 at launch, quick escalation if >=1 SEV

How to read this doc quickly:
- Pre-launch gates (must be green to proceed), Day-of runbook (sequences), Post-launch monitoring (72h checklist), Contingencies and rollback criteria, Open questions.

Pre-launch gates (owners + acceptance):
1) Contract & SDKs (owner: Product SDK lead - Priya Nair)
   - Acceptance: SDKs updated and published (py/ts/rust), integration smoke snippet run against staging.
   - Output artifact: SDK release tag, smoke test run id (JIRA-PRJ-1789).

2) Serving/runtime validation (owner: Serving Runtime - Jordan Miles)
   - Acceptance: 3x baseline QPS at target latency on canary infra for 10m, KV cache warm-start validated.
   - Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU utilization, memory pressure.

3) Observability & alerting (owner: Observability - Evelyn Park)
   - Acceptance: Dashboards deployed, alert thresholds configured in PagerDuty for SEV+High, on-call rotation updated for launch window.
   - Must include: token accounting stream, percentiles by route, error breakdown by model variant.

4) Billing & tagging (owner: Finance Ops - Ravi Kapoor)
   - Acceptance: Usage rows mapped to billing SKU, test billing events emitted from staging and validated against ledger.
   - Blocker if: any untagged routes or token counters diverge by >2%.

5) Security & privacy (owner: Security - Maya Chen)
   - Acceptance: KMS keys attached, audit-only logging validated, required DLP transforms enabled for PII-containing routes.

6) Playbook & comms (owner: Product Ops - Maya Chen)
   - Acceptance: Stakeholder comms ready (launch email + rollback criteria), customer-facing docs ready in /docs/launch-notes.

Day-of high-level runbook (T-2h -> T+8h):
- T-2h: Canary warm-up (small percentage of traffic -> 5%); run smoke suite (10m), confirm no elevated error rate.
- T-1h: Increase canary to 20%, monitor for 30m. Check billing events for mapping and latency SLOs.
- T-15m: Read out green/amber/red from owners. If any red, pause and triage.
- T0: Ramp to 50% for 30m -> if stable, proceed to 100% over 60m with stepwise increments (50% -> 75% -> 100%). Avoid bursts >2x expected QPS.
- T+1h: Confirm token accounting and billing logs are present; sample customer session traces for errors.
- T+4h: First full metrics summary to GTM + Eng (automated snapshot).
- T+8h: Decision checkpoint for extended monitoring (if amber: extend manual on-call to 72h).

Post-launch 72h monitoring checklist (owners):
- Continuous: 5m granularity dashboard for total errors, p95 latency, 2xx ratio, billing event parity.
- Hourly: Ops email digest with top 5 error signatures and top 3 latency regressing routes.
- 12h: Run a model-quality sampling job on 1k generated outputs and check for regressions vs baseline prompts.
- 24h: Business review: usage vs forecast, cost delta, and CS backlog (customer tickets).

Rollback / mitigation criteria (explicit, one or more triggers):
- Trigger A (user-impacting): sustained error rate >0.5% for 30m or any SEV opened by customer success referencing launch feature -> immediate rollback to previous model/route mapping.
- Trigger B (performance): p95 latency >3x baseline for 20m -> slow down ramp to previous step and engage Serving Runtime.
- Trigger C (billing): token accounting divergence >5% across major routes for 60m -> pause rollout and investigate tagging pipeline.

Contingency play snippets (short actions):
- If rollback: toggle routing policy to previous blueprint (owner: Platform Eng) and run short canary sanity checks (5m).
- If partial degradation: enable fallback model-variant with reduced hallucination risk (owner: Applied ML).
- If billing mismatch: flip test ledger mode and capture full event stream for post-mortem (owner: Finance Ops).

Open items & follow-ups (tracked tickets):
- Integrate per-route cost tag into /telemetry pipeline (JIRA-PRJ-1865) - owner: Ravi Kapoor
- Autoscale burst policy mismatch between staging and prod; update cluster config template (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342) - owner: Jordan Miles
- Canary error spike root-cause triage (in progress) - link: JIRA-PRJ-1789 - owner: Evelyn Park

Decision log (short):
- 2025-11-03: doc created; initial gate list drafted by Product Ops.
- 2025-11-10: Serving runtime required additional KV cache warm-start tests (added).
- 2026-02-19: Billing mapping failure discovered in staging -> required mitigation and added blocking criteria for launch.

Quick references (where to look):
- Full launch playbook (Confluence): CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM/LaunchPlaybook/4521
- Canaries & infra runbooks: github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/canary.md
- SDK release tags: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases

Notes to reviewer (informal):
- This is intentionally compact — goal is a single-sheet ops artifact that can be pasted into the launch Slack channel and used as the canonical T-minus checklist.
- I left some TODOs as tracked JIRA items rather than burying them here; want to keep doc scannable.

If you have changes, please add inline comments or push an updated doc version (document_version key).

-- end of doc --
